description: Tests two weaknesses: (1) implicit/passive health capture — health data mentioned casually without explicit labeling; (2) synonym-based recall — user queries using medical terminology (edema, fatigue) when log entries use lay language (swollen ankles, sluggish). Also tests multi-day sleep log aggregation and single-mention BP reading.
